sources.title: whisper-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Whisper-base is a speech recognition and translation model with 74 million parameters built by openai. It is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture trained on 680,000 hours of labeled speech data using large-scale weak supervision. sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.snippet: Whisper base Model Overview Whisper is a pre-trained model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Whisper models demonstrate a strong ability to generalise to many datasets and domains without the need for fine-tuning. The models were trained on either English-only data or multilingual data.
